notes.title: Singleplayer Patch
notes.content:
So after lots of request for checkpoints(because people keep dying in trial room), I decided to fix this problem.
Now if you die in trial room, you will respawn at the entrance of the room again with a message from party master.
Blocked entrances of "you cheated" in red street because lots of people was going there accidentaly(People can still use yellow slide to go "you cheated")
Removed one collapsing floor in dark zone because it would be to annoying to die to that and restart.
This changes only apply to singleplayer btw, nothing changed in multiplayer.

notes.title: Hotfix 2.1
notes.content:
-Bad audio in entity footsteps fixed.
-Bacteria scream now have a 15 seconds cooldown.
-Minor UI fixes.
-Turkish language support added.

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
Upcoming patch notes for today's update:
-Fixed menu stuck on screen after a round restart.
-Fixed can't use inputs after a round restart.
-Fixed text going out of screen.
-Added borderless setting.
-Completely reworked spectating.
-Added motion sensors.
-Randomized entity spawns.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3
notes.content:
-Minor UI fixes
-Chinese language support added.

Working on Russian and Turkish support.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1
notes.content:
Fixed a bug causes game to stuck after dying in singleplayer.(It should restart after 5 seconds now)

Know Issues:
-Reloading the map while settings is open can cause game to stop getting inputs.
-Crashing mid-game causing connection problems(Restart the game again to solve).
